paragraphs.source_en: “I’m ready for the Jackal’s traps, Fitchner. Or Apollo’s. It makes no difference. They won’t be able to stop what’s coming for them.”

units.source_en: “I’m ready for the Jackal’s traps, Fitchner.

ja.t: はできている、フィッチナー。

units.source_en: They won’t be able to stop what’s coming for them.”

ja.t: っているものを、やつらには

paragraphs.source_en: “No,” Fitchner says, hesitating a moment. “Not their traps. The girl’s.”

I answer him in a way he will understand. “Fitchner. Do not play me for a fool with vague, annoying references to duplicity. My army is mine, won in heart and body and soul. They can no more betray me at this point than I can betray them. We are something you have not seen before. So stop.”

units.source_en: I answer him in a way he will understand.
Do not play me for a fool with vague, annoying references to duplicity.
My army is mine, won in heart and body and soul.
They can no more betray me at this point than I can betray them.
We are something you have not seen before.

paragraphs.source_en: He shakes his head. “This is your fight, boyo.”

“Yes. It is my fight.” I smile. Now is the time I’ve been waiting for. “Fitchner, hold up,” I say before he reaches the door. He stops and looks back. I kick back my chair and stride over to him. He eyes me curiously. Then I stick out my hand. “Despite everything, thank you.”

units.source_en: Now is the time I’ve been waiting for.
“Fitchner, hold up,” I say before he reaches the door.
I kick back my chair and stride over to him.
Then I stick out my hand.

ja.t: 「いろいろあったが、ありがとう」

paragraphs.source_en: He clasps it. “Good luck, Darrow,” he says. “But take care of Sevro. The little shit will follow you anywhere, no matter what I say.”

units.source_en: The little shit will follow you anywhere, no matter what I say.”

ja.t: おうと、おまえについてどこへでも

paragraphs.source_en: “I’ll take care of him. I promise.” My Helldiver grip tightens on his hand.

units.source_en: My Helldiver grip tightens on his hand.

paragraphs.source_en: For a moment, if only a moment, we are friends. Then he winces at the pressure my hand is putting on his. He laughs at first, then he understands and his eyes widen.

units.source_en: For a moment, if only a moment, we are friends.
Then he winces at the pressure my hand is putting on his.
He laughs at first, then he understands and his eyes widen.

paragraphs.source_en: That’s when I break his nose and slam my elbow into his temple till he no longer moves.

units.source_en: That’s when I break his nose and slam my elbow into his temple till he no longer moves.
